ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (22) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

The attribution «Браминская мудрость. Рамакришна.» (Braminskaya mudrost'. Ramakrishna, 'Brahmanic wisdom. Ramakrishna') is restored in full where the website draft gave only 'Ramakrishna', and Emerson's attribution stays without a final period as printed. In the closing thought «то, что в тебе самое дорогое» (to, chto v tebe samoye dorogoye) is 'what is dearest in you', not 'to you'; in the Persian saying «живи в мире» (zhivi v mire) is read as 'live in peace'.
